findings.key_quote: iPhone net sales increased during the first quarter of 2026 compared to the same quarter in 2025 due to higher net sales of Pro models.
findings.justification: This passage directly states that iPhone net sales increased in Q1 2026 (three months ended December 27, 2025) compared to Q1 2025 (same quarter in 2025) and explicitly attributes the cause to 'higher net sales of Pro models.' The period matches exactly (EXACT_MATCH status), and the statement is about observed results, not forward-looking. This entails the assertion that the increase was due mainly to higher sales of Pro models.

findings.key_quote: Three Months Ended December 27, 2025 December 28, 2024 iPhone ® $ 85,269 $ 69,138
findings.justification: This provides the iPhone net sales figures for the three months ended December 27, 2025 ($85,269M) and December 28, 2024 ($69,138M), confirming an increase occurred. However, it does not address the cause of the increase (whether it was due to Pro models or other factors), so it is related but not deciding on the causation assertion.

findings.key_quote: iPhone net sales increased during the third quarter and first nine months of 2025 compared to the same periods in 2024 due to higher net sales of Pro models.
findings.justification: This passage discusses iPhone net sales increases in different periods (Q3 2025 and first nine months of 2025) and attributes them to Pro models. However, the period_status is MISMATCH because these are different periods than the claim period (Q1 2026, three months ended December 27, 2025). Evidence from a different period does not decide the claim about Q1 2026.

findings.key_quote: iPhone net sales increased during 2025 compared to 2024 due to higher net sales of Pro models.
findings.justification: This passage discusses iPhone net sales for fiscal year 2025 (12 months ended September 27, 2025) and attributes the increase to Pro models. However, the period_status is MISMATCH because this is a different period (full fiscal year 2025) than the claim period (Q1 2026, three months ended December 27, 2025). Evidence from a different period does not decide the claim.

findings.key_quote: Americas net sales increased during the first quarter of 2026 compared to the same quarter in 2025 primarily due to higher net sales of iPhone and Services.
findings.justification: This passage discusses regional (Americas) net sales increases attributed to iPhone and Services, but does not address the specific cause of the iPhone net sales increase (whether Pro models or other iPhone models drove the increase). It is on topic but does not settle the causation assertion about Pro models.
